name: Whisper
tagline: Whisper is a speech recognition model published by OpenAI as open source
description: Whisper is a speech recognition model published by OpenAI as open source. Open-source software; the repository lists the licence as MIT.
useCases: Transcribing speech to text on your own machine
strengths: Source code and licence are public in the official repository
No licence fee for the software itself
limitations: You run and maintain it yourself, so hosting, hardware and support costs are your own
We have not run or benchmarked it

openSource.note: The official repository lists the licence as MIT

free.details: The software is free to use under its MIT licence; infrastructure and any hosted offerings are separate.

plans.name: Self-hosted (open source)
plans.note: Free software under the MIT licence; your own hosting and hardware costs apply

pricing.regional: No vendor price list. Any hosted or commercial offering from the same team is priced separately and is not covered here.

verification.notes: Project active (about 111.6k stars; recent commit). MIT license shown. No pricing: open-source software; OpenAI's hosted transcription API is billed separately.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: A general-purpose speech recognition model you run yourself

capabilities.title: Transcribe speech
capabilities.text: Multilingual speech recognition from audio files.

capabilities.title: Translate to English
capabilities.text: Speech translation turns non-English speech into English text.

capabilities.title: Handle long recordings
capabilities.text: Long files are transcribed with a sliding 30-second window.

featureCards.name: Six model sizes
featureCards.text: From tiny to large, plus a turbo model.

featureCards.name: English-only models
featureCards.text: The .en models tend to do better for English, especially the smaller ones.

featureCards.name: Turbo
featureCards.text: An optimised version of large-v3 with faster speed and minimal accuracy loss; it is not trained for translation.

featureCards.name: Voice activity detection
featureCards.text: Listed among the tasks the model was trained on.

featureCards.name: Command line and Python
featureCards.text: Use a whisper command or load a model in Python.

audienceDetail.text: Install it with pip and call it from Python. The page does not name an audience, so these groups follow from how it is used.
The page invites sharing of web demos, integrations and ports.

scenarios.title: Transcribe an audio file
scenarios.text: Run the command-line tool on it.

scenarios.title: Translate foreign speech into English
scenarios.text: Use a medium or large model.

scenarios.title: Detect the language of a clip

gettingStarted.text: pip install -U openai-whisper, with a recent Python.
Use the command-line tool with a model name, or load a model in Python and call transcribe.
You may need Rust for tiktoken or setuptools-rust on some platforms.
